speech_text:
Flash Flood Warning issued October 4 at 3:41PM AST until October 4 at 3:45PM AST by NWS San Juan PR.

The heavy rain has ended. However, ponding of water over roads remains possible due to previous rains. Please continue to heed remaining road closures.
